prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A production videogame SPRITE ATLAS, exactly NINE DIFFERENT isolated modular Yautja-inspired environment props on real transparent background, a strict3columns×3rows grid of equal square cells. Canvas1536×1536, nine512×512cells. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete object centered horizontally with its ground contact near cellbottom450px, generous transparent gutter30pxminimum. No overlaps between cells, no labels, no gridlines, no background. ALL props share the same fixed ORTHOGRAPHIC camera: yawZERO, front/SOUTH facing us, looking down35degrees to north. Straight front horizontals, verticals straight, north-south depth recedes straight UP screen, top surfaces visible but no perspective convergence and no isometric45degree corner turn. Same detailed handpainted realistic HD2D art, dark basalt and blackened bronze materials, warm neutral light upperleft. Original lore-friendly domestic/civic design, not claimed canonical. No humans, no skull decor, no recognizable weapons. Row1LEFT: long low basalt-and-bronze BENCH, fronthorizontal seat, solid supports, broadtop visible. Row1CENTER: closed rectangular ribbed equipment CHEST with latch, flat top, frontface straight. Row1RIGHT: tall upright alien storage LOCKER with shut ribbed metal panels and no text. Row2LEFT: freestanding short angled-top civic CONSOLE, dark amber display panel facing south, low weighted base; no floating hologram. Row2CENTER: compact enclosed crafting WORKSHOP unit with amber protected furnace vent and worktop, no smoke/flames/weapons. Row2RIGHT: low long REST COT with dark tanned hide cushion and restrained alien metal frame, fronthorizontal length, no human pillow. Row3LEFT: low rectangular MEAL TABLE with two simple dark ceramic bowls, table front horizontal and top visible; no chairs. Row3CENTER: small volcanic ROCK with one sparse tough reddish alien plant growing alongside, one combined landscaping clump, no huge leaves. Row3RIGHT: low square-based civic BEACON/bollard, topplate seen from35degrees and amber statuslight in FRONT face, no cornerturned viewpoint. Each object is isolated with complete feet visible and NATIVE ALPHA transparent gutters. Nine independently usable sprite cells, all styled to match massive basalt/bronze Yautja city dwellings.
